thread:
maria: Quick q — prototyping a Console feature: per-field authoring guidance + live example templates you can insert into the YAML editor. Thinking of adding a way to attach named examples to route groups. Thoughts?

aj: Nice. Two quick concerns: (1) how do examples map to our JSON schema (is this an x- extension?), and (2) will we run any validation on the example payloads or just store/display them?

lint-bot: NOTICE: new rule candidate 'x-console-examples' flagged in draft mode — no blocking behavior yet.

kevin: I think we should use an opt-in schema extension like `x-console:examples`. That keeps core schema clean but lets Console consume helpful metadata. We can also add `x-console:exampleId` on routes to reference shared snippets.

olga: example snippet so you get the shape I'm proposing:
```yaml
routes:
  - id: identify-by-header
    match:
      - header: x-customer
        pattern: '^acct-\d+$'
    x-console:
      examples:
        - id: acct-sample
          summary: 'enterprise header example'
          payload: |
            headers:
              x-customer: acct-12345
            metadata:
              plan: premium
```

sam: FYI the preflight linter currently errors when `payload` contains YAML anchors or merge keys (we saw this with `<<:` in some old snippets). We'll need the linter to either ignore example blocks or run an example-safe parse.

aj: Also need telemetry: we should know which template a customer picks (not the full content). Proposed event: `route.authoring.template_used` with props { template_id, org_id, editor_mode }. No full YAML in events.

maria: Agreed on telemetry minimalism — we do NOT want customer route data sent. template_id + hash + editor_mode is enough. Also mark templates that contain secrets as disallowed.

kevin: For the linter change: add a new test dir `tools/lint/tests/x_console_examples` with small fixtures. Use jest + snapshot for rule messages, and a `safeParseExamples` helper to strip anchors before validation. I can PR the helper.

olga: Can we add an autofix suggestion that will convert common anchor patterns into expanded form in examples only? That would make copying snippets from docs less painful. Should be explicit opt-in button though.

maria: UX plan: feature behind an org-level toggle -> default off. Rollout to 20% of orgs, collect template_used telemetry, then enable autofix suggestion per-org. Docs will explain `x-console` semantics.

lint-bot: DEPLOY: rule 'x-console-examples' added to experimental lint set (non-blocking). See CI job #lint-ctl-188 for smoke tests.

sam: One last note — migration for legacy routes: if route has `example:` top-level, Console should map that to a generated `x-console.examples` entry during import, but do NOT mutate persisted route until user saves.

maria: Thanks all — I'll open a small RFC with design and telemetry snippets and assign follow-ups. :)

kevin: I'll pick up the linter helper + tests after the RFC lands.

olga: I'll prototype the editor insert UI next sprint (drag/drop snippet + preview).

aj: Cool. cc @security for the secrets check later.
